label: Orbit Swap
css: #dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="example-orbit-swap"]{background:radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 50%,#2a1830,#120c14 70%)}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="example-orbit-swap"] .orbit-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;container-type:size}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="example-orbit-swap"] .orbit-ring{position:absolute;inset:0;animation:orbit-spin 48s linear infinite}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="example-orbit-swap"] .dyn-card{position:absolute;width:16%;height:28%;margin:0;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);outline:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);transition:opacity .28s ease}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="example-orbit-swap"] .dyn-card.is-swap{opacity:.15}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="example-orbit-swap"] .dyn-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}@keyframes orbit-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
